decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.

changes.quote: Available indicators suggest that economic activity has been expanding at a solid pace.
changes.explanation: The Fed upgraded its description of economic growth from moderate to solid, showing more confidence in the economy.

changes.quote: Job gains have remained low, and the unemployment rate has shown some signs of stabilization.
changes.explanation: The language reflects that hiring is still sluggish, though joblessness has stopped rising rapidly.
The Fed removed the note that inflation had recently moved up, keeping focus on price pressures still being above target.

changes.quote: The Committee is attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate.
changes.explanation: The Fed dropped explicit mention that downside risks to employment had recently risen, taking a more balanced view.

changes.quote: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.
changes.explanation: Instead of lowering rates like it did previously, the Fed opted to hold interest rates steady.

tone_quotes.quote: Available indicators suggest that economic activity has been expanding at a solid pace.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 21.39% APR costs about $89.12 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.26% and moved +2 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.06% would rise by about $3.87 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 4.4%, and employers added an average of -39k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 3% over the past year (December 2025); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.9%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 0.2% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +3 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -0.01%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.05% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that future choices will depend on incoming data and evolving risks.
